title: Aisha Wahab wins special election to serve out remainder of Eric Swalwell's term
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. The story centers on this: Aisha Wahab wins special election to serve out remainder of Eric Swalwell's term. In simple words, The partial term for California's 14th Congressional District ends January 2027, after which the candidate chosen in the November election will serve the next full term Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
